signIn.title: Sign in to NomadFinance
signIn.subtitle: Protect your pay, your contract and the money you send home.
signIn.phoneHint: We'll send a 6-digit code by SMS.

error.invalidPhone: That mobile number doesn't look right. Check the country code and number.
error.invalidCode: That code is wrong. Check the SMS and try again.
error.codeExpired: That code has expired. Send a new one.
error.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
error.network: No internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
error.securityCheck: The security check didn't pass. Refresh the page and try again.
error.unavailable: This sign-in method isn't available right now. Try another one.
error.accountExists: This email already uses a different sign-in method. Use that one instead.
error.generic: Sign-in didn't work. Please try again.
